parse_dense_format: convert a dense D x 6 atom embedding numpy array into sparse parent-child topology format with positions and chi angle masks
cif_to_embed: parse a mmCIF structure file into node embeddings using gemmi for neural network input
compute_dihedral: compute the dihedral angles of all atoms in a protein structure given parent-child topology and 3D coordinates
rotate_dihedral: rotate a protein representation by a set of dihedral angles using parent-child topology and chi angle validity masks
load_rotamor_library: load the Dunbrack rotamer library CSV files into a pandas DataFrame dictionary keyed by amino acid name
